scope: task-title taxonomy and coverage website only; vendor QA intentionally excluded

l1.name: Laboratory
l1.description: Wet-bio and bench-top manipulation: vessels, pipetting, transfer, mixing, filtration, rinsing, and lab organization.

l1.name: Medical / First Aid
l1.description: Child-resistant bottles, gauze, bandages, dressings, simulated ointment, and first-aid kit handling.

l1.name: Workbench
l1.description: Large fasteners, screwdrivers, wrenches, clamps, measuring tape, cables, assembly, and organization.

l1.name: Office
l1.description: Documents, hole-punching and stapling, computer peripherals, cables, mugs, headphones, and office organization.

l1.name: Kitchen
l1.description: Containers, liquid transfer, utensils, food items, cleaning, wrapping, and storage.

l1.name: Bedroom
l1.description: Clothing folding, zippers and buttons, hangers, pillowcases, blankets, and storage.

l1.name: Packing / Shipping
l1.description: Boxes, tape, bubble wrap, labels, mailers, packing, sealing, and unpacking.

l1.name: General / Teleop Alignment
l1.description: Legacy tasks retained for semantic alignment with single-arm teleoperation benchmarks.

l1.name: General / Active Tactile
l1.description: Legacy tasks centered on tactile judgement that do not naturally belong to one everyday scene.

l2.name: Open / Close / Seal
l2.description: Caps, lids, latches, zippers, buttons, bag seals, and other state transitions.

l2.name: Pick / Move / Place
l2.description: Pick-and-place, transport, pose adjustment, rack placement, tray placement, and storage.

l2.name: Insert / Remove / Align
l2.description: Alignment with holes, ports, rack positions, or vessel openings, followed by insertion or removal.

l2.name: Pour / Container Transfer
l2.description: Liquid transfer by tilting vessels, pouring through funnels, or using large utensils.

l2.name: Pipette / Dispense / Inject
l2.description: Small-volume or measured liquid manipulation with pipettes, droppers, or syringes.

l2.name: Mix / Stir / Agitate
l2.description: Stirring, swirling, rolling, inversion mixing, and pipette mixing.

l2.name: Rinse / Wipe / Drain
l2.description: Rinsing, brushing, wiping, draining, drying, and waste-liquid handling.

l2.name: Solids / Weighing / Filtration
l2.description: Particle or powder transfer, weighing, filter-paper handling, and filtration.

l2.name: Tool Use / Assembly / Fixing
l2.description: Screwdrivers, wrenches, clamps, hammers, staplers, punches, and assembly actions.

l2.name: Flexible Materials / Wrap / Fold
l2.description: Gauze, bandages, clothing, tape, film, cardboard, bubble wrap, and other deformable materials.

l2.name: Measure / Label / Document
l2.description: Measurement, labeling, drawing, paper handling, filing, and document-oriented manipulation.

l2.name: Active Tactile / Press / Classify
l2.description: Pressing, squeezing, and tasks that explicitly depend on tactile judgement such as softness or weight.
